nodes.description: Ownership address in Owned; initialised to msg.sender in the constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address in Owned, set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Emergency stop flag in ZygStop, toggled by stop()/start() and read by the stoppable modifier.
ERC20Interface reference to the Zygoma token contract used for token payouts.
Owned.transferOwnership(address) sets newOwner; guarded by onlyOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership() requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner.
ZygStop.stop() sets stopped = true; onlyOwner.
ZygStop.start() sets stopped = false; onlyOwner.
BuyZygoma.withdrawTo(address,uint) sends contract Ether to an arbitrary address; onlyOwner and notThis.
BuyZygoma.withdrawERC20TokenTo(ERC20Interface,address,uint) transfers arbitrary ERC20 tokens out; onlyOwner with validAddress/notThis.
Internal buyToken() computes the token amount from msg.value and forwards tokens to msg.sender.
Payable fallback function guarded by stoppable that routes incoming Ether into buyToken().
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
BuyZygoma constructor storing the Zygoma token contract address.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used for ownership, access control checks and as transfer recipient.
to.transfer(amount) sends Ether to an externally supplied address inside withdrawTo.
token.transfer(to, amount) external call on an arbitrary ERC20 contract inside withdrawERC20TokenTo.
zygomaAddress.transfer(msg.sender, amount) external token payout inside buyToken.
uint amount = msg.value * 350000; plain multiplication without SafeMath, potential integer overflow.
amount parameter of withdrawTo, the wei value forwarded to the recipient.
to parameter of withdrawTo, the Ether recipient address.
Local amount in buyToken holding msg.value * 350000 tokens.
_newOwner parameter of transferOwnership written into newOwner.
token parameter of withdrawERC20TokenTo, the arbitrary ERC20 contract invoked.
to parameter of withdrawERC20TokenTo, the token recipient address.
amount parameter of withdrawERC20TokenTo, the token quantity transferred.

edges.reason: transferOwnership writes the _newOwner argument into the newOwner state variable.
onlyOwner on transferOwnership compares msg.sender with owner to authorise the call.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the handover.
stop() writes true into the stopped state variable.
start() writes false into the stopped state variable.
stop() is gated by onlyOwner, which checks msg.sender == owner.
start() is gated by onlyOwner, which checks msg.sender == owner.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The owner state variable is initialised from the untrusted msg.sender.
BuyZygoma constructor stores the supplied token contract in zygomaAddress.
withdrawTo executes to.transfer(amount) on the supplied recipient.
The amount parameter is the value sent by to.transfer(amount).
The to parameter is the destination of the Ether transfer.
withdrawTo is restricted by onlyOwner, comparing msg.sender against owner.
withdrawERC20TokenTo performs the external call token.transfer(to, amount).
The token parameter is the external ERC20 contract whose transfer is invoked.
The to parameter is the recipient passed to token.transfer.
The amount parameter is the quantity passed to token.transfer.
withdrawERC20TokenTo is restricted by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
buyToken computes amount = msg.value * 350000 without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
buyToken calls zygomaAddress.transfer(msg.sender, amount) as the payout step.
msg.sender is the recipient argument of the token payout transfer.
The computed multiplication result is used as the token amount in the payout.
The payable fallback function invokes buyToken() on every incoming payment.
to.transfer performs an external Ether call to an attacker-supplied address from withdrawTo.
token.transfer invokes attacker-supplied ERC20 code during withdrawERC20TokenTo.
zygomaAddress.transfer calls the external token contract while buyToken is executing.
The stoppable modifier on the fallback function reads stopped before executing the body.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to feed the transfer inside withdrawTo and should be merged into that function node.
The to parameter is the recipient used by withdrawTo and can be folded into the function node.
The local amount variable is the direct result of the msg.value * 350000 multiplication and belongs to that unsafe operation.
_newOwner is only used to assign newOwner inside transferOwnership and is subsumed by the function.
The token parameter is the external contract target of withdrawERC20TokenTo and is merged into the function.
The to parameter is the direct recipient argument of the external token.transfer call.
The amount parameter is the direct value argument of the external token.transfer call.
